links.outcome: Reference label quality (ingredient omissions) in Nutrition5k, assessed by four annotators on 440 images
links.effect: Annotators found systematic omissions in original labels; after correction, extrapolated Jaccard for Gemini 2.0 Flash rose from 0.62 to an estimated 0.82, so raw scores underestimate true performance.
links.quote: A human validation study in which four annotators reviewed 440 images revealed systematic omissions in the original Nutrition5k labels.

unlisted_practices: Comparing model cost per 1,000 images alongside accuracy for model selection
Comparing prompt strategies for image-based dietary assessment

screen.reason: The study benchmarks multimodal vision-language models for dietary assessment on the Nutrition5k dataset, evaluating accuracy, cost, and prompt strategies across ten models.
